title: ABC pick, warehouse collection and shipment lifecycle
summary: A limited current-local source snapshot of American Book Company warehouse fulfillment. It distinguishes print jobs, collection confirmation and actual shipment quantities. Customer org parity and recovery authorization are unverified; no order records, recipient details or integration credentials are included.

claims.text: Repository documentation describes a Salesforce commerce, sales and fulfillment application for educational print/digital products. Pick Lists represent warehouse printing work; Ship Lists represent collection checks before the separate packaging and Create Shipment process.

markPicked accepts separate book-job and guide-job IDs, records printing fields, and performs user-mode updates. Ship List creation belongs to PickListTriggerHandler, which acts on transition into Printed and checks existing related ship rows before inserting. A Printed-to-Printed save skips that transition.

The bulk Ship List uses one book collection check and separate guide checks. Only fully checked visible book rows enter Mark Ready to Ship; complete books can proceed while other books still await required guides. The action saves checks, confirms the captured IDs and refreshes the list.

The shared worksheet helper suppresses guide rows for Preview Copy orders even if an older response contains a guide count. Other required guide collection checks remain locked until printing and after row completion. The box-complete predicate requires the book check and any displayed guide check.
limitations: Guide quantity calculation and historical variants are outside this curated subset.

claims.text: Lifecycle policy distinguishes packed/Ready to Ship quantities from actual shipped and delivered quantities. Partial shipment remains partial; sufficient delivered quantities are distinct from Completed, which also requires digital fulfillment when applicable and settled billing. A warehouse status check is not proof of carrier delivery.

Proposed diagnosis for a printed job missing from a Ship List: inspect its current print state, related ship-row existence, captured transaction failure and user access. Do not toggle statuses to manufacture a transition or blindly rerun Mark Printed: the existing Printed-to-Printed path intentionally skips ship-row creation.

Proposed diagnosis for a disabled readiness action: compare the current filtered rows, book collection checks, guide presence/printing/collection and save state. If an order is only Ready to Ship, inspect actual shipment-item quantities before asserting it is shipped. No warehouse fact should be inferred from a UI click alone.

Proposed owner-reviewed sandbox checks: an already-Printed save does not add another ship row; a missing guide check keeps its book pending while a complete sibling is eligible; filtering limits the confirmed IDs; Preview Copy has no guide row; a partial actual shipment does not become fully shipped. These are source-derived candidate checks, not completed acceptance.

Printing/collection state changes, missing-row repair, shipment creation, carrier replay, invoice changes and lifecycle reconciliation require a concrete customer-approved operation, native access, audit, postcondition and idempotency design. This knowledge import registers no recovery and authorizes no customer data or external write.

Live ABC source parity, current order data, carrier/payment/accounting state, approved Aegis instrumentation and customer-specific recovery success criteria have not been verified. Historical release notes do not prove the current org state.
